name: Analog Twin-Stick Control
author: KFII-PC
description: True analog camera and movement on a modern twin-stick layout: left stick walks and strafes, right stick turns and looks. The game's own control code still runs -- the mod writes the per-frame turn, pitch, forward and strafe velocities the game would have accumulated from held buttons, so collision, animation and speed limits are untouched and only the amount is continuous.
